answer: Use a funding-lineage escalating bond. (1) Each agent registers with the wallet that funded it, leaving a visible money trail. (2) The first identity from one wallet locks $200 for 30 days; the second locks $400, the third $800, doubling each time. (3) Auditors trace each lineage on-chain, and any identity faking its funding loses its bond. (4) Honest agents keep a haven of trust while attackers drown: 10 clones burn $204,600, and 1,000 clones cost more than the ocean of crypto holds. Like a comet that flares bright then dies, a sybil swarm burns its own fuel before reaching shore.
